title: Italian Crispy Corn Fritters
description: A crispy and spicy Italian-inspired fritter recipe using corn and a hint of Italian seasonings. Perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine corn kernels, flour, breadcrumbs, egg, mozzarella cheese, spicy pepper flakes, and Italian seasoning. Mix well.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Using a spoon, drop small portions of the corn mixture into the hot oil.
4. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
5. Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Serve the Italian crispy corn fritters hot and enjoy!
